priority_items.title: Matui: Napuati tells RNZ cargo-only / 10 Sep warning; PMO flags inquiry; arrest still unconfirmed
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ Pacific (17 Sep 07:22 NZST / 19:22 UTC) interviews VMSA Commissioner Napuati: Matui certificate was cargo-only; never authorised passengers; personnel-overflow warning 10 Sep; s.108 / Shipping Act charges still sought, not confirmed. RNZ found Tui listed numbers deactivated; Napuati says he was unaware of the 2 Jun business-name strike-off and that VCIR should have notified VMSA. PMO Wednesday statement via RNZ: independent investigation 'will be instigated shortly'; no-revenge appeal to families. Daily Post homepage still HTTP 200 / request-only. VFSC still no Tui extract. Toll band still 2 dead / ~30+ missing. Family-list 53 CLAIM. Not FLASH.
